description: Tamil Nadu announces India's first AI city 'Arivagam', enhancing industrial growth and investment with strategic initiatives and infrastructure.
body_lead: Tamil Nadu Finance Minister N. Marie Wilson on Wednesday (August 5, 2026) said since assuming office, the Tamilaga Vettri Kazhagam (TVK)-led State government has signed seven memoranda of understanding (MoUs) worth ₹35,062 crore, with the potential to create 14,790 direct and indirect employment opportunities.
